snippet.title: Humphrey Yang
snippet.description:
Former Financial Advisor (Series 7, 66), Previously worked in Gaming. Explainers, Personal Finance, Reviews & More.

My friends would ask me finance questions all the time, so I made this channel so I could send them videos answering those questions. I love explaining things simply, and making it fun and easy. This channel is great for beginners and intermediates who are looking to build wealth, learn how to keep their wealth, and get better with personal finance, budgeting, and investing. I also focus a lot of self improvement and productivity, so if you're into that - I hope you stick around!

snippet.title: Finance Simply Explained
snippet.description:
Welcome to Finance Simply Explained, your go-to channel for learning personal finance, investing, and wealth creation — in plain English. Our mission is simple: to make finance easy for everyone. We break down complex topics like the stock market, real estate investing, cryptocurrency, passive income, budgeting, and financial freedom strategies into clear, actionable lessons you can actually use in everyday life.

Whether you’re trying to understand how money works, start investing, or grow your wealth faster, our videos give you step-by-step explanations, real-world examples, and strategies used by successful investors and entrepreneurs.

From beginner investing tutorials and money management tips to economic breakdowns and market updates.

⚠️ Disclaimer
This video is created for educational and entertainment purposes only. It should not be considered financial or investment advice. Always do your own research or consult with a licensed professional before making financial decisions.
